MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #10 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 我叫 wǒ jiào mean when it comes before a name? (1 mark)
   A. My name is
   B. Where is
   C. I like
   D. I am going to

2. How is the sound ü written after the initials j, q and x? (1 mark)
   A. As ü with two dots
   B. As o
   C. As plain u, as in qù
   D. As i

3. What does 谁 (shéi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Younger sister
   B. Love
   C. Older brother
   D. Who

4. Which Chinese word means "this"? (1 mark)
   A. 那 nà
   B. 哥哥 gēge
   C. 妹妹 mèimei
   D. 这 zhè

5. What does 椅子 (yǐzi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Chair
   B. In front of
   C. Left side
   D. House

6. Fill the blank: 椅子在桌子____。 (The chair is under the table.) (1 mark)
   A. 下
   B. 是
   C. 里
   D. 上

7. What are the three steps of good imitation? (1 mark)
   A. Listen, repeat, compare and correct
   B. Read, draw, colour
   C. Copy, hide, forget
   D. Talk, sleep, walk

8. What does 昨天 (zuótiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mosque
   B. To go
   C. Yesterday
   D. Week (short form)

9. Which Chinese word means "they"? (1 mark)
   A. 送 sòng
   B. 他们 tāmen
   C. 祝 zhù
   D. 唱歌 chànggē

10. What does 切 (qiē) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To wish
   B. They
   C. To cut
   D. Friend

11. What does 喝 (hē) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Milk
   B. To eat
   C. Drinks
   D. To drink

12. Which sentence means "What is this?"? (1 mark)
   A. 这是香蕉。
   B. 这是什么?
   C. 我喜欢吃香蕉。
   D. 我早饭吃饼。

13. Which Chinese word means "to touch"? (1 mark)
   A. 用 yòng
   B. 摸 mō
   C. 哭 kū
   D. 肩膀 jiānbǎng

14. In the song 头、肩膀、膝盖、脚, which word is a joint in the leg? (1 mark)
   A. 头
   B. 脚
   C. 肩膀
   D. 膝盖

15. What is a good safety tip in strong rain? (1 mark)
   A. Play near the river
   B. Stay away from fast rivers
   C. Shelter under a tall tree in a storm
   D. Ignore warnings

16. Which sentence means "Today there are clouds."? (1 mark)
   A. 今天天气很好。
   B. 雨很大。
   C. 今天下雨。
   D. 今天有云。

17. What does 前面 (qiánmiàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Table
   B. In front of
   C. Television
   D. Door

18. Which sentence means "Where is the sofa?"? (1 mark)
   A. 沙发在哪儿?
   B. 门在左边。
   C. 冰箱在厨房。
   D. 床在卧室。

19. Which Chinese word means "classmates"? (1 mark)
   A. 同学们 tóngxuémen
   B. 叫 jiào
   C. 我 wǒ
   D. 你 nǐ

20. What does 老师 (lǎoshī) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To be called
   B. Teacher
   C. You
   D. And you? (a question word)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain when we use 吃 and when we use 喝. (2 marks)

22. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 明天 and 二. (2 marks)

23. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 月 and 太阳. (2 marks)

24. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "And you?" (2 marks)

25. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door." (3 marks)

26. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 左边 and 房间. (2 marks)

27. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Friday, go to the mosque." (3 marks)

28. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "My name is Xiaoming." (2 marks)

29. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The garden is on the right of the house." (3 marks)

30. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 菠菜 and 下面. (2 marks)

31. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "What is this?" (2 marks)

32. Explain how nǐ hǎo is really said, and why. (2 marks)

33. Write these position words in Chinese with pinyin: beside, above and below. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #10 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — My name is
   叫 means to be called, so 我叫 introduces your name.

2. C — As plain u, as in qù
   After j, q and x the two dots are dropped, but the sound is still ü.

3. D — Who
   谁 (shéi) means who.

4. D — 这 zhè
   这 (zhè) means this.

5. A — Chair
   椅子 (yǐzi) means chair.

6. A — 下
   下 means under.

7. A — Listen, repeat, compare and correct
   Good imitation means listening carefully, repeating, then comparing with the speaker.

8. C — Yesterday
   昨天 (zuótiān) means yesterday.

9. B — 他们 tāmen
   他们 (tāmen) means they.

10. C — To cut
   切 (qiē) means to cut.

11. D — To drink
   喝 (hē) means to drink.

12. B — 这是什么?
   这是什么? (zhè shì shénme?) means "What is this?".

13. B — 摸 mō
   摸 (mō) means to touch.

14. D — 膝盖
   膝盖 is the knee.

15. B — Stay away from fast rivers
   Floods are dangerous and fast rivers are unsafe.

16. D — 今天有云。
   今天有云。 (jīntiān yǒu yún.) means "Today there are clouds.".

17. B — In front of
   前面 (qiánmiàn) means in front of.

18. A — 沙发在哪儿?
   沙发在哪儿? (shāfā zài nǎr?) means "Where is the sofa?".

19. A — 同学们 tóngxuémen
   同学们 (tóngxuémen) means classmates.

20. B — Teacher
   老师 (lǎoshī) means teacher.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: We use 吃 with foods to say eat, and we use 喝 with drinks to say drink.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verb.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: 明天: míngtiān, tomorrow. 二: èr, two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: 月: yuè, month. 太阳: tàiyáng, sun.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: 你呢? nǐ ne?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: 左边: zuǒbian, left side. 房间: fángjiān, room.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期五,去清真寺。 xīngqīwǔ, qù qīngzhēnsì.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我叫小明。 wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: 花园在房子右边。 huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: 菠菜: bōcài, spinach. 下面: xiàmiàn, below.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is said like ní hǎo, because when two third tones come together, the first changes to a second tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the changed sound and 1 mark for the rule.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: 旁边 pángbiān, 上面 shàngmiàn, 下面 xiàmiàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
